name: Pinky Ponky 1 - Beautiful Dream
original_name: ぴんきぃぽんきぃ１ びゅうてぃふるどりぃむ
source:
The first chapter in the Pinky Ponky series is an adult dating game combining elements of simulation and visual novel. The player character is a young male who is seeing an erotic dream. The game depicts his fictional encounters with various young women in different locations, and the gameplay consists entirely of selecting dialogue lines or (in advanced stages) sex-related actions. Each girl has a satisfaction bar that must be increased by choosing the right lines. Some choices won't affect that bar, while others will reduce it, sometimes drastically or instantly leading to the scenario's end. The game usually requires the player to discover near-perfect series of lines to advance to the next dating segment. Failure to do so prematurely concludes the scenario, leading to the next one.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/58836/pinky-ponky-dai-1-shu-beautiful-dream/]MobyGames[/url]]

Scenario titles:
1. 恐怖のタコヤキ女 (starring Chisato)
2. 深夜の診療室 (starring Sumiko)
3. おかたいのはお好き？ (starring Miki)
4. ぞくぞく！！　青い体験 (starring Hitomi)
5. 恋の手ほどき (starring Reiko)
translation:
《Pinky Ponky》系列第一作是一款成人約會遊戲，融合了模擬與視覺小說元素。玩家操縱一名正在做春夢的年輕男子。遊戲描繪他在不同地點與多名年輕女性展開的虛構邂逅，玩法完全由選擇臺詞以及後期出現的性行為動作構成。每名女孩都有一條滿意度槽，玩家必須選擇正確臺詞來提高數值。有些選項不會影響滿意度，有些則會使其下降，降幅有時極大，甚至會立刻導致當前故事結束。玩家通常需要找出近乎完美的一連串臺詞，才能進入下一段約會。若未能做到，當前故事便會提前結束，遊戲隨即轉入下一篇。
